utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Vik—sorry, I’m a little scattered, but I think the repair drive is Saturday morning by the laundry room, and we’re starting with the wobbly porch steps. Are you helping with tools or repairs?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Noah—since the time and drop-off spot still aren’t confirmed, I’ll keep telling folks we’re gathering repair needs and volunteers for now. I can help spread the word once Rosa or the organizers confirm the final details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Good call, Vik—thanks for not letting my half-remembered details become official. I’ll stick to saying we’re gathering needs and volunteers until Rosa or Marta confirms the time and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Opal—glad you asked about the repair drive. This Saturday is sign-ups only, no tool drop-off yet, and I’m still looking for intake volunteers and a few basic tool kits if you know anyone.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara—I’ll note Saturday as sign-ups only and make sure nobody brings tools or items yet. I’ll ask around for intake volunteers and basic tool kits, then send you names and locations as I confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Opal—that’s exactly what we need. If you can send names and locations as they firm up, I’ll pass them along to Rosa and keep Mina in mind for the matching schedule.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Bo, I’m still waiting on confirmed details from Opal or Rey about who’s organizing and which repairs are covered, but I’m keeping track of folks who can help once that’s clear.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, Jules—I only skimmed the thread too, but I’ll tell folks to hold tight and sign up with what they’re bringing once Opal or Rey confirms the details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Bo—let’s keep it light for now so nobody commits on fuzzy info, and I’ll ping you as soon as Opal or Rey confirms the organizer and repair categories.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still waiting on the final time and place, Dane, but the key thing is to get people signed up ahead with what they’re bringing so the repair folks can prep parts and tools.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, Ira—I’ll start collecting names, repair items, and what tools or parts folks can bring, but I’ll mark the time and place as pending until we get the manager’s confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, Dane—thank you. I’ll keep asking around while I’m out, and as soon as I get the confirmed time and place I’ll pass it along so your list can be updated.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Kira, I’m updating the repair drive supply list—do you know if you’re bringing any tools, spare parts, duct tape, or batteries?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not committing supplies yet, Cleo—has Opal confirmed who’s officially organizing it and exactly which repair categories are covered?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Not yet, Kira — I’ve only heard Marta’s collecting by the laundry room Saturday morning, so I’ll mark you as waiting on Opal’s confirmation before listing anything from you.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Gus, word is the repair drive is aiming for Saturday the 18th, 9 to noon at the community room by the park, but the room calendar still needs confirming. If folks ask, tell them small appliances, lamps, bikes, and simple clothing repairs are likely welcome—no fuel items, heavy furniture, or cracked screens.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Got it, Tess—I’ll tell folks Saturday the 18th is tentative until the room calendar’s confirmed, and I’ll keep the welcome list clear: small appliances, lamps, bikes, and simple clothing repairs only.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks Gus—just keep saying “tentative” nice and loud until Rey or Opal confirms the room. I’ll circle back the second I hear it’s locked in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Sam, we’re aiming for Saturday 9 to noon, with bikes and small appliances first. I’m sorting the sign-up list around school pickup schedules and can send you the finalized version this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Faye—that helps a lot. If you can send the finalized signup list this afternoon, I’ll fold it into the repair list and get Mina the names in time to match folks.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Sam—I’ll send you the finalized sign-up list this afternoon, with bikes and small appliances marked first and the porch rails/screen doors kept separate.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Pia. We’re aiming for Saturday the 18th, 9 to noon, at the community room by the park, and I’m waiting on Sam’s final repair and volunteer list before we spread it too widely.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Morning, Eli—that sounds workable, but let’s hold off until Sam’s list is in and we’ve confirmed who’s handling sign-ups and extension cords for the tables.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Agreed, Pia—let’s wait on Sam’s list, then we’ll pin down sign-ups and extension cords before any flyer goes out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Uli, I think Saturday is just for repair sign-ups, not tool collection—though please check me on that, because I’ve already tangled it twice today.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I think Saturday morning is mainly the repair work and sign-ups by the laundry room; Mara’s keeping the tool-kit list with Rosa, so we don’t need a separate collection unless she says so.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh! See, I had it half-wrong again—thanks, Uli. I’ll tell folks Saturday morning is repair work and sign-ups by the laundry room, and leave the tool-kit list to Mara and Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Nell, I’m trying to keep my notes tidy for Saturday—do you know where the repair tables are going, or who’s keeping the main sign-up list?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Rey — I only know second-hand that Saturday 9 to noon is by the mailboxes, and Oren thought it might just be for sign-ups. I’d check with Mara or maybe Cleo before trusting my version.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Nell — I’ll mark “by the mailboxes” as tentative and check with Mara or Cleo before I tell anyone else. I’m only there the first hour, so I’d rather not mix up the list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Quinn, the repair drive is Saturday 9 to noon by the mailboxes. Uli needs help with the cracked edge and a couple potholes; I’m bringing a shovel and patch mix.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Leo, quick correction before I pass anything along: the repair drive is Saturday the 18th, 9 to noon, at the community room by the park—not the mailboxes. I’m still confirming table layout and sign-ups, and potholes sound like a separate fix-up crew from the repair tables.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Quinn—I'll correct that: Saturday the 18th, 9 to noon at the community room by the park. I’ll keep the pothole crew separate until Uli confirms.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Rosa, do you have any confirmed repair items or volunteer names yet, or are we still waiting on Sam and Quinn before I can assign people?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’ve got early repair categories from Opal—small appliances, wobbly chairs, and a few bike issues—but not a firm item list yet. The event is now Sunday at the community center, so let’s hold assignments until Sam and Quinn confirm volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sunday at the community center, got it—but wobbly chairs may conflict with Quinn’s no heavy furniture note, so please confirm that detail and send me any names the minute Sam or Quinn verifies them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Sam, sorry I’m late jumping in—sounds like I’m handling sign-ups and check-ins, but I’m still trying to confirm the table area approval and the exact Saturday setup by the laundry room.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries, Dane—yes, please keep sign-ups and check-ins with you, and if you can confirm the table approval and laundry-room setup today, I’ll fold that into the clean list I’m sending Mina.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, Sam—I’ll chase down the manager approval today and confirm the laundry-room setup, then send you the details for Mina’s list.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Opal, before I put my name down, can you confirm who’s officially organizing the repair drive and exactly which repair categories are covered?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Kira, I’d hold off on calling anything official yet—Rosa has the sign-up sheet moving, Ira’s still confirming time and place, and the likely categories I’ve noted so far are small appliances, chairs, and bikes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Opal — I’ll hold off, then. Once Ira confirms the time and place, can you also verify whether Rosa is the official organizer and whether those three categories are final?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Jules, I’m still waiting on Sam’s confirmed list—do you know any definite repair items or signed-up helpers, or should I keep chasing Sam directly?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I don’t have definite repair items or signed-up helpers confirmed yet, Mina—Opal and Rey are still the names I’m trying to verify through. I’d keep chasing Sam directly for the list, and I’ll share anything solid as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, I’ll keep pressing Sam directly, but please text me the minute Opal or Rey confirms anything definite. I need item types and helper names, not maybes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Leo—quick note for the repair drive: this Saturday is sign-ups only, no tool drop-off yet. Could you or Noah take a short intake shift to help Rosa keep things moving?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, I can take a short intake shift Saturday morning. Tell me the time slot and what Rosa needs tracked.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo—that’s a big help. I’ll confirm the exact morning slot with Rosa, but for intake please track names, contact info, repair item, and whether they need help carrying it in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Pia — I’m still piecing it together second-hand, but I heard Saturday may just be for repair sign-ups, not supply drop-off yet. I’m waiting on someone to confirm the collection spot before I bring anything.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds sensible, Nell—let’s not have people hauling supplies over until the spot is confirmed. Do you know who’s keeping the official sign-up list Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not totally sure, Pia — I only heard the repair window is Saturday 9 to noon by the mailboxes. I’d check with Mara or maybe Uli before telling folks anything official.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. If you can tell folks Saturday morning by the laundry room and mention the mailbox side first, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, Uli — Saturday morning by the laundry room, and I’ll point folks to start on the mailbox side first. I’ll pass that along, and I’ll remind people to sign up with what they’re bringing too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Bo. I’m a little stretched thin, so having you handle the messages means more than I can say.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Gus, I’m glad you asked—I’m waiting on Faye’s confirmed repair list this afternoon, so for now I only know bikes and small appliances seem likely to be first priority.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Hana—that helps. I’ll set aside the bike stand, basic wrenches, and my small appliance tester for now, then adjust once Faye’s list comes in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds perfect, Gus—thank you. I’ll let you know as soon as Faye confirms the final priorities and any signup gaps, and I’ll keep anything uncertain clearly marked.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Cleo, we’re aiming for Saturday 9 to noon for the repair drive, starting with bikes and small appliances. I’m sorting the sign-up list around school pickup schedules this afternoon—are you hoping to help or just get something fixed?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m helping track supplies, Faye, so I’ll note Saturday 9 to noon for bikes and small appliances. Do you know what we’re shortest on right now—tools, spare parts, or things like tape and batteries?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Cleo—that’s a big help. I think we’re shortest on bike tubes, batteries, and basic tape for now, but I’ll confirm once I finish matching the sign-up list this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Rosa, have you heard anything definite about the repair drive—date, drop-off spot, or what they need? I’m ready to spread the word, but only once it’s solid.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, it’s confirmed now: the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center. Please spread that, and mention we’re still collecting volunteers, tools, and repair needs.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh perfect, thank you, Rosa—I’ll spread that it’s Sunday at the community center, and that folks can still bring volunteer hands, tools, and repair needs.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still waiting on the final time and place, but the important thing for now is getting people to sign up ahead and note what they’re bringing so the volunteers can prep.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, thanks Ira — sign-ups first, and folks should note what needs fixing or what they can bring later so the volunteers can plan. I’ll try not to tell anyone to haul tools over this Saturday unless you confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Exactly, thanks Oren—hold off on Saturday or tool details until I confirm the time and place, but please do nudge people toward signing up with what they need fixed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Rey, the date and basics are set now: Saturday the 18th, 9 to noon, in the community room by the park, for small appliances, lamps, bikes, and basic clothing repairs. I’m still holding off on wider invites until I confirm the table layout and who’s owning sign-ups.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn—that helps. Once you’ve got the table layout and sign-up person confirmed, I can quietly pass the basics to Tess and check whether Mrs. Alvarez’s screen door belongs on a separate home-repair list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Rey—please hold it quietly for now, and I’ll circle back as soon as the layout and sign-up lead are confirmed. And yes, Mrs. Alvarez’s screen door should stay on a separate home-repair list, not the repair drive.
